state:
Goal `core-sse-and-2-more`. Every `Core\Sse` member but `upgrade` has all its feature proofs on disk:
`stream` gained `about.md`, three examples, an attack and a bench with a fresh perf record, under
`docs/examples/core/Sse/stream/`, `tests/hostile/core/Sse/stream/` and `benches/members/core/Sse/stream.nvs`.
`upgrade` now has its Rust `covers:` test, and owes `about.md`, examples, attack and bench. Those
cannot run yet: `nvs run --request` offers a request only the WebSocket slot, so `Core\Sse::upgrade`
under a `.nvsr` throws the "needs a request a server is answering" `RuntimeError`. A server offers the
SSE cell to every request (`crates/nvs-host/src/isolate.rs:416`). `Core\Storage` still owes everything
but its Rust tests and a card. The last sweep's `Core\Cli` to `Core\Crypto` floor and selftest failures
did not reproduce; the one real red, `audit checks` finding the old proofs name in
`tools/nv/select/config.ts`, is fixed. The goal's `[context] modules` now names
`crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs` and `crates/nvs-cli/src/events.rs`.

next.title: `Core\Sse::upgrade` runnable from `nvs run`, then its proofs

items.text: **`nvs run --request` offers the SSE cell and starts the stream it was left** — `rule:concurrency/two-doors-one-isolate`: offer an `SseSlot` to every `--request` inbound beside the WebSocket one at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:2548`, and after a request that ended normally take it next to the socket arm at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:2814`, running the program with `nvs_host::Isolate::over_event_stream` (`crates/nvs-host/src/isolate.rs:498`) and printing the drain as `--events` does. The hard part is that the `--events` publisher (`crates/nvs-cli/src/events.rs:132`) needs the *connection* isolate's inbox, which exists only once that isolate is built inside the task; without `--events` the stream should end as a client that left does. A `-p nvs-cli` test and a `.nvst`-free example pin it; update `docs/examples/README.md` § *Values published to an event stream* to say `--events` beside a `.nvsr` feeds the upgraded stream.

**`Core\Sse::upgrade` proofs** — `rule:testing/feature-proofs`: `about.md`, three examples with a `.nvsr` each (a `GET` needs no upgrade headers), one attack modelled on `tests/hostile/core/Socket/upgrade/01-huge-and-deep-arguments-for-a-connection.nvs`, one bench modelled on `benches/members/core/Socket/upgrade.nvs` (`iterations 1`); the member is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:535` and its card `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:264`.

**`Core\Storage` class card, then `get`, `delete` and `list` proofs** — `rule:core-api/reference-card`: a `ClassDoc` above the class's `CLASS` row in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:168`, and the class struck from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5283`.

backlog: `Core\Sse::stream` allocates 6 times per call off a connection (`docs/perf/members.ndjson`); the declared headers are most of it. Not a bug, only worth a look if a request opens many streams.
